Entire now tracks only this hackathon repository: `lambegraham/hackathon`.

The extra native repo `/et/any-resets/anyresets` was empty and checked out as a second git repo inside this folder. That repo, the `any-resets` project around it, and the local `anyresets/` checkout are gone. The account project list is empty, and the only mirror left is this GitHub repo.

Tracking on this checkout is on for Cursor and Codex. Git commit hooks are installed here, so checkpoints stay with this repo and push to `origin`. Cursor’s hooks live in `.cursor/hooks.json`, which is still untracked.

The same repo is mirrored in two regions: EU (`aws-eu-central-1`) and US (`aws-us-east-2`). Say if you want the US copy removed.
